title: Fermi's countdown to criticality as Chicago Pile-1 was built, November 1942
description: Bar chart of Fermi's measure, the square of the pile's radius divided by the neutron intensity, which falls towards 1 as the pile nears a self-sustaining chain reaction: 390 at the 15th layer, 320 at the 19th, 270 at the 25th and 149 at the 36th. Fermi calculated that it would reach 1 between the 56th and 57th layers; the pile stopped at the 57th. Data: Wikipedia, Chicago Pile-1.
heading: CHICAGO PILE-1 · FERMI'S COUNTDOWN · R² ÷ INTENSITY
